topPRs.title: fix(#14476): purge dead /help view deep-links + regenerate stale e2e bundles
topPRs.author: lalalune
topPRs.body:
Follow-up to #14536 (merged) closing out the fable must-fixes for #14476 (remove tutorial + help views; tutorial → in-chat tour, help → knowledge). The must-fix items were still live on `develop` after the merge.

## What was still dead on develop

- **Dead `/help` view deep-links + "help center" copy** in two onboarding-notification mirrors:
  - `packages/ui/src/components/shell/NotificationsHomeCenter.stories.tsx` (~L112/L115)
  - `packages/ui/src/components/shell/__e2e__/notifications-center-fixture.tsx:25/28`
- **Stale committed e2e bundles** still baking in the removed `tutorial: "/tutorial"` / `help: "/help"` `TAB_PATHS` routing:
  - `packages/ui/src/components/shell/__e2e__/output-home/home-screen.html`
  - `packages/ui/src/components/shell/__e2e__/output-launcher-loop/launcher-loop.html`

## Changes

1. Repointed the "Get help any time" notification row to `deepLink: "/chat"` and matched the canonical seeder copy in `packages/agent/src/runtime/onboarding-notifications.ts` (help is answered in the chat, not a help-center view). Both the story and the e2e fixture now mirror the seeder exactly.
2. Regenerated both e2e bundles via the esbuild-bundling runners (`bun run --cwd packages/ui test:home-screen-e2e` and `test:launcher-loop-e2e`). The bundles are written at page-setup time (before the touch batches), so the regenerated HTML is complete; `tutorial: "/tutorial"` / `help: "/help"` are gone from both.

Legitimate non-view `/help` text is deliberately left untouched: the in-chat `/help` **slash command** (slash-menu tests / `ContinuousChatOverlay`) and the Telegram bot `/help` capability copy (`cloud.telegram.capability4`).

## Verification

Grep — no live `/help` view refs remain:
```
$ grep -rn 'deepLink: "/help"' packages/ui/src --include="*.ts*" | grep -v __e2e__/output   → NONE
$ grep -rni "help center" packages/ui/src --include="*.ts*" | grep -v __e2e__/output          → NONE
$ grep -rn 'tutorial:.*"/tutorial"\|help:.*"/help"' packages/ui/src/navigation/index.ts        → NONE
$ grep -c 'tutorial: "/tutorial"\|help: "/help"' .../output-home/home-screen.html               → 0
$ grep -c 'tutorial: "/tutorial"\|help: "/help"' .../output-launcher-loop/launcher-loop.html    → 0
```

Vitest (`bun run --cwd packages/ui vitest run src/state/notifications/navigate-deep-link.test.ts src/navigation/index.test.ts`):
```
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  20 passed (20)
```

Biome (`bunx @biomejs/biome check NotificationsHomeCenter.stories.tsx`): `Checked 1 file. No fixes applied.` (the `__e2e__` fixture is in a biome-ignored path.)

`test:home-screen-e2e`: **PASSED** (regenerated `output-home/*` from a clean run).

`test:launcher-loop-e2e`: the HTML bundle regenerated successfully, but the run's later **gesture-fuzz property assertion** (`applied ≥ 500 touch actions`) failed **flakily** on this heavily-loaded machine (a concurrent gesture-loop e2e was pinning a core at ~94% CPU; batch 1 passed with 100 actions, batch 2 aborted early). This assertion is orthogonal to the content change — it stress-tests touch gestures, not routing. Only `launcher-loop.html` (the actual stale-code fix) is committed from that run; the run's churned `.webm`/`brand-scan.json` were restored to avoid committing failing-run noise. An owner on an unloaded machine should confirm the gesture gate is green.
